item: Row 430: a backup taken without newsletters carries no per-day keyword count of a newsletter mention
summary: The newsletter filter on a backup's snapshot copy (plaintext and the keyed encrypted path) deleted the newsletter articles and their mentions but left keyword_day_counts, which held SUM(count) per day and keyword including those mentions. A restore never merges that table (it is rebuilt after the epoch bump), so no figure on screen was wrong; the FILE still carried per-day counts derived from content the user chose to leave out. The filter now reads the days the deleted mentions fell on, rebuilds each built day WHOLE from the copy's remaining mentions with the table's own arithmetic (R101), and clears the stale mark the delete trigger set; a day the copy never built is left for its build. Tests: the copy's day rows equal the GROUP BY truth and differ from before, no stale mark left; an unbuilt day is not written.
